claim_scope: Consumed development mechanism qualification only; no effectiveness, generalization, efficiency, Official, or SOTA estimate.
prior_result: V2 naturally activated persist and reached automatic replay. HARK replay invalidated an earlier path choice; the same Agent redirected later work but the append-only program retained all invalid prefix steps.
hypothesis: When replay falsifies an earlier recorded operation, a strong Agent in the same session will naturally revise that indexed operation and use replay of the edited program as its next executable test.
case_selection: Use only the already consumed HARK case that generated the V2 representation counterexample. It is selected for mechanism opportunity, not for an effectiveness endpoint.

method.only_change_from_v2: Add one non-shell revise_program action that replaces or deletes one indexed current-program step and immediately clean-replays the revised whole.
mechanisms: one arbitrary-Bash shell with model-declared inspect or persist effects
complete public-goal observation after every append
automatic target-state replay on construction-goal Pass
model-selected replacement or deletion of one indexed program step
immediate target-state replay after every plan edit
same-session reasoning with an unchanged active construction environment

qualification_observations: whether a replay counterexample invalidates an earlier recorded step
first revise_program request and edit type
replay outcome immediately after the edit
whether the invalid prefix remains in the current program
requests, tokens, wall time, network traffic, and storage

decision_policy.mechanism_qualified: After replay evidence invalidates an earlier recorded step, the Agent selects replace or delete and the harness clean-replays the revised program in the same tool turn.
decision_policy.opportunity_absent: No replay counterexample invalidates an earlier recorded step in the fresh trajectory; the episode is censored for edit activation.
decision_policy.mechanism_rejected: An edit opportunity occurs but the Agent only appends compensating steps, or the selected edit does not change and replay the indexed current program.
decision_policy.effect_claim: No effect or efficiency claim is permitted from this consumed case regardless of terminal outcome.
decision_policy.promotion_claim: Mechanism qualification only licenses fixing V3 for a later outcome-blind paired development comparison.

execution.provider: OpenRouter fixed DeepInfra route without fallback
